description:
[Game reference] Every vehicle: health, fuel per minute, seats, storage and vendor price. One row per vehicle (`key`, `name`, `category` air/water/land/rail, `hp`, `seats`, `storage_slots`, `fuel_per_min` at full
throttle, `buy_scrap` at the Air Wolf or boat vendor, `url`). Fetch everything about one with `/vehicles/{key}`. Vehicle keys for get_vehicle. Link https://rust.wiki/vehicles.
name: list_vehicles
title: Every vehicle: health, fuel per minute, seats, storage and vendor price
